summary:
Reviewed the ModMount FAQ page for the requested withdrawal processing and withdrawal fee information.
The FAQ states: “The withdrawal process takes about 8 to 10 business days to get your withdrawal request. Please note that it may differ depending on your local bank.” This means withdrawals are not described as instant and may vary by bank.
The FAQ states: “The Company reserves the right to charge a withdrawal fee depending on the circumstances. You can find all the relevant information in the General Fees document. Please review it carefully.” It therefore does not confirm that withdrawals are free.
Completed both requested lookups on https://www.mod-mountltd.com/en/faq/.
